note: Anonymous source-equivalent routes are exercised by generic live diagnostics. Synthetic private workflows are deliberately deferred from the anonymous diagnostic and are exercised by the site pytest and Playwright suites with a site-scoped temporary database.

deferred.next: Requires a verified synthetic member and completed intake; covered by materials/betterhelp/clone/tests/test_app.py and test_browser_e2e.py.
deferred.member: Requires a verified synthetic member; covered by the site suites.
deferred.matches: Requires completed synthetic intake; covered by the site suites.
deferred.therapist-detail: Requires a concrete seeded provider id and signed-in member; covered by the site suites.
deferred.saved: Requires a signed-in member and saved provider state; covered by the site suites.
deferred.booking-details: Requires a concrete site-scoped booking id; covered by the site suites.
deferred.booking-payment: Requires a concrete booking and local sandbox payment state; covered by the site suites.
deferred.booking-confirmation: Requires an approved local sandbox payment; covered by the site suites.
deferred.booking-history: Requires a signed-in member and seeded/persisted bookings; covered by the site suites.
deferred.permission-isolation: Requires two synthetic actors and direct backend assertions; covered by the site pytest suite.

states_out_of_scope.source-private-success: Source questionnaire completion, matching, booking, mail and payment success semantics are unavailable because source mutations are unauthorized.
states_out_of_scope.source-private-errors: Source private validation and recovery semantics were not captured; local deterministic simulations are not claimed as source-direct evidence.
states_out_of_scope.formal-three-frame-calibration: Most source checkpoints have one or two independent frames rather than the required three-frame stability calibration; visual contracts remain provisional and differences must be reported.
